_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'History Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 10, Part I: History of Southern Africa, Topics 10.1-10.5. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for the other 2013 OBC subjects in this app. As with the other OBC syllabi processed, this document's printed outcome numbering codes drift (most sub-topic outcomes in 10.2 and 10.4 are all printed under one shared code prefix rather than incrementing), so outcomes were reconstructed positionally against each sub-topic heading rather than trusting the printed codes. Under 10.3, only 5 outcomes are printed for 6 named sub-topics; the outcome 'Describe the arrival of the European settlers at the Cape' clearly covers both 10.3.1 (arrival of the Dutch) and 10.3.2 (arrival of the British) together, so those two sub-topics are merged into one entry here rather than inventing a second outcome. This is distinct from the CBC_2023 History syllabus already in this app (history_form1.json, Form 1 only, Ordinary Level 2024 syllabus) — this file is the older 2013 Outcome-Based Curriculum's senior-secondary History syllabus. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 10 is modeled as a single term here.

topics.name: 10.1 Geographical Setting
topics.description: Part I: History of Southern Africa.

sub_topics.name: 10.1.1 Physical and Climatic Features of Southern Africa

competencies.description: Describe the physical and climatic features of Southern Africa and their influence on the distribution of people

topics.name: 10.2 Indigenous Communities
topics.description: Part I: History of Southern Africa.

competencies.description: Discuss the socio-economic and political organisation of the Saan and Khoi-khoi
Describe the movements of Bantu-speaking people into Southern Africa
Describe the establishment of kingdoms and nation-states in south-eastern South Africa
Explain the causes and results of the Mfecane

sub_topics.name: 10.2.5 Relationships Between the Bantu and Saan and Khoi-khoi

competencies.description: Explain the conflict between the Khoi-Saan and the Bantu

topics.name: 10.3 European Settler Communities
topics.description: Part I: History of Southern Africa.

sub_topics.name: 10.3.1-10.3.2 Arrival of the Dutch and British at the Cape

competencies.description: Describe the arrival of the European settlers at the Cape

sub_topics.name: 10.3.3 Relationship Between the British and Dutch Settlers at the Cape

competencies.description: Explain the conflicting political and economic interests between the British and the Dutch
Describe the causes and course of the Great Trek
Describe the steps leading to the Union of South Africa

topics.name: 10.4 Race Relations in Southern Africa
topics.description: Part I: History of Southern Africa.

sub_topics.name: 10.4.1 Relationships Between Indigenous Africans and the White Settlers

competencies.description: Describe the socio-economic interactions between the European settlers and the indigenous communities

sub_topics.name: 10.4.2 African Resistance to White Domination and the Rise of African Nationalism

competencies.description: Explain the reasons leading to African resistance to white domination

topics.name: 10.5 Majority Rule
topics.description: Part I: History of Southern Africa.

competencies.description: Describe the various liberation movements in South Africa after the formation of the Union of South Africa
Describe the process leading to the end of Apartheid and introduction of majority rule
Analyse the social, economic, political and industrial developments in post-Apartheid South Africa
